placements.why: The envelope's content is entirely about calibrating the Kestrelwood spectrograph and verifying it against June reference plates. This names the Calibration organizational category — one of the org's known strata areas — that holds calibration-related narrative leaves. No existing strata or structure exists to attach to.
placements.title: Instrument calibration as a verifiable organizational practice
placements.theme: Calibration activities establish and verify instrument readiness against reference standards.

placements.title: Calibration established and verified against reference standards
placements.theme: Instrument calibration is set at a target frequency and confirmed against reference plates to validate observational fidelity across the full band.
placements.why: All four segments support the theme of establishing and verifying instrument calibration. src-1 and src-2 are Quill Ashgrove's assertive statements that the spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and verified against June reference plates across the full observing band. src-3 and src-4 declaratively specify the instrument and calibration parameters. Together they evidence a calibration-verification subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
